openData.title: Open data for Braga urban transport.
openData.lede: Datasets in standard formats. No signup, no API key.
openData.availableLede: REST endpoints returning RFC 7946 GeoJSON in WGS 84 coordinates. Works with QGIS, Mapbox GL, Leaflet, geopandas and any modern GIS tool.
openData.devLede: Paste into your terminal or editor. Endpoints are public — no Authorization header or API key required.
openData.catalogCardDesc: Machine-readable JSON-LD metadata, automatically harvestable by dados.gov.pt and European regional portals. Lists all datasets, distributions and the responsible operator.
openData.roadmapLede: Standard datasets planned for upcoming sprints. Standards from the European public transport ecosystem.
openData.licenceText: Datasets are published under CC BY 4.0. You may use, redistribute and adapt freely, including for commercial purposes, provided that you credit the source. No warranties.

routes.title: Operating routes
routes.description: Geometry of every operating line. Each feature is a LineString with the actual path between stops (GTFS shapes or OSRM fallback).

stops.title: Bus stops
